# golden
# Generated: 09.05.2026, 09:19:09

# == RULE 1: [launch for c4 - knobs] knob 1 → [loopy] util (1) [+I] ==
# trigger-source: [mapping] "launch for c4 - knobs"
# consumer-source: [device] "10"
IF M0 == B1 29
  SND B9 7F 01 +I
END

# == RULE 2: [launch for c4 - knobs] knob 1 [0-17] → [c4 octave] voice 1 octave -3 (1) ==
# trigger-source: [mapping] "launch for c4 - knobs"
# consumer-source: [mapping] "c4 octave"
IF M0 == B1 29
  IF M2 >= 0x0
    IF M2 <= 0x11
    ASS M0 = B1
    ASS M1 = 17
    ASS M2 = 01
    SND M0 M1 M2
  END
  END
END

# == RULE 3: [launch for c4 - knobs] knob 1 [18-35] → [c4 octave] voice 1 octave -2 (2) ==
# trigger-source: [mapping] "launch for c4 - knobs"
# consumer-source: [mapping] "c4 octave"
IF M0 == B1 29
  IF M2 >= 0x12
    IF M2 <= 0x23
    ASS M0 = B1
    ASS M1 = 17
    ASS M2 = 02
    SND M0 M1 M2
  END
  END
END

# == RULE 4: [c4] voice 1 octave = 1 → [c4 octave view] octave -3 (0) ==
# trigger-source: [device] "2"
# consumer-source: [mapping] "c4 octave view"
IF M0 == B1 17 01
  ASS M0 = B9
  ASS M1 = 01
  ASS M2 = 00
  SND M0 M1 M2
  BLOCK
END

# == RULE 5: [c4] voice 1 octave = 2 → [c4 octave view] octave -2 (1) ==
# trigger-source: [device] "2"
# consumer-source: [mapping] "c4 octave view"
IF M0 == B1 17 02
  ASS M0 = B9
  ASS M1 = 01
  ASS M2 = 01
  SND M0 M1 M2
  BLOCK
END

# == RULE 6: [loopy] util = 1 → [c4 voices view] touch voice 1 (0) ==
# trigger-source: [device] "10"
# consumer-source: [mapping] "c4 voices view"
IF M0 == B9 7F 01
  ASS M0 = B9
  ASS M1 = 00
  ASS M2 = 00
  SND M0 M1 M2
  BLOCK
END
